name: Tabannusi: Builders of Ur

categories.label: Victory points on score track (incl. final District scoring)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (đã gồm chấm điểm Quận cuối game)
categories.hint: VP accumulate on the track during play and from the 5 District scorings; after the final round every District is scored once more, then add that to your marker.

categories.label: Fulfilled Urban cards
categories.hint: Reveal your Urban cards; add printed VP of each one whose condition you meet. Each House can count for only one Urban card.

categories.label: Unused Harbormaster tiles
categories.hint: 3 VP for each Harbormaster tile you never used.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, players share victory.

endCondition.description: Triggered when the last Gold leaves the Time track; finish the round so turns are equal, play one more full round, then score all 5 Districts and Urban cards.

notes: family: area-majority. Most points are gained during play (District scoring: building size x Mastery track level, Port and Ziggurat scoring, ships, bonus spaces) and recorded on the VP track, so scoreTrack is one input. Final steps: score all 5 Districts once more, then reveal Urban cards. Ziggurat tile and Urban card values are printed on components (see rulebook appendix). Solo/Automa mode not modelled.

sources.title: Tabannusi: Builders of Ur rulebook (Board&Dice, EN)
sources.section: pp.20-21 Scoring and Game End (Triggering Game End, final scoring, tiebreaker); p.17 Harbormaster tile; Appendix Urban cards
